plainText:
Billy Regan (born William Regan Timoney on March 5, 1958 in Teaneck, New Jersey) is an American actor, voice actor, director, script writer and producer who works for the English-language dub of . He is also credited under the names of Bill Timoney and Billie Regan.

==Biography==
Regan was born on March 5, 1958, in Teaneck, New Jersey. As an adult, he became a voice actor and was involved in a number of English-dubbed versions of Japanese anime series. He joined during , with his first role being Dr. Yung, the antagonist of The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon. Regan currently resides in Locust, New Jersey.
